structure Crowds (δ B : ℝ) {S : StepData c f} (T : Tube G S) (x : ℝ) (V : Config G c) : Prop where
  positive (i : Cell c) : temp x < toll V i → toll V i ≤ δ → T.low.direct/4*temp x*toll V i ≤ T.workC (till x) V (temp x) i
  middle (i : Cell c) : toll V i ≤ temp x → -(B*temp x^4) ≤ T.workC (till x) V (temp x) i
  last (i : Cell c) : δ < toll V i → -(T.low.linear*temp x*toll V i) ≤ T.workC (till x) V (temp x) i

proof_context.conclusion: `Crowds` states `workC >= low.direct/4*temp*toll` for `temp < toll <= delta`, `workC >= -(B*temp^4)` for `toll <= temp`, and `workC >= -(low.linear*temp*toll)` for `toll > delta`.

refine ⟨δ,hδ,P.below.clip.direct*K/2,by positivity,fun L W => ⟨?_⟩⟩
  filter_upwards [ultimately_cool δ hδ] with x hx
  intro c f S _ _ T hT _ A U k V _ _
  refine ⟨fun i hs ht => ?_, fun i hi => ?_, fun i hi => ?_⟩
  · exact workC_mid T _ V _ i hx.1 hs ((h _ ht).2)
  · rw [← hT.low]
    exact workC_small T _ V _ i hi K hK.le (h _ (hi.trans hx.2)).1
  · have he : temp x < toll V i := hx.2.trans_lt hi
    have ht : 0 < toll V i := hx.1.trans_lt he
    apply le_trans ?_ (workC_large T _ V _ i hx.1 he)
    have hd := T.low.quadratic_pos
    have hs := hx.1
    have hk : 0 ≤ T.low.direct * (temp x / toll V i / 2) * ‖G.curvature (faceValue V i)‖^2 := by positivity
    linarith only [hk]

proof_context.conclusion: The three ranges follow from `workC_small`, `workC_mid`, `workC_large` with `B = direct*K/2` and the common `delta`.
